hints.title: Top Left Diagonal Predecessor Comparison
hints.text: A matrix is Toeplitz if every diagonal from top-left to bottom-right has identical elements. Can comparing each interior element with its immediate diagonal neighbor verify this property?

hints.title: Diagonal Equivalence Invariant
hints.text: For every cell at row r and column c with r greater than zero and c greater than zero, matrix[r][c] must equal matrix[r - 1][c - 1].

hints.title: Interior Grid Neighbor Comparison Procedure
hints.text: Iterate through all rows starting from index 1. For each row, iterate through all columns starting from index 1. Compare matrix[r][c] with matrix[r - 1][c - 1]. If any pair is unequal, return false immediately. If all pairs match, return true.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(M * N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Collecting diagonals individually into lists requires extra memory and complex index boundary tracking.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct neighbor comparison checks each cell once in O(M * N) time using O(1) auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement the simple one-step neighbor comparison and discuss memory streaming for very large matrices.
